title: Legal Executive
requiredSkills: Contract Support
Draft, review, and manage standard agreements (NDAs, vendor agreements, SaaS contracts, consultancy agreements).
Maintain the central repository of contracts and track renewals/expiry dates.
Ensure execution and filing of contracts in line with company policies.
Compliance & Governance
Support compliance with IT laws, data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act), and internal policies.
Assist with corporate secretarial activities including board resolutions, filings, and documentation.
Maintain legal checklists and ensure timely updates.
Legal Research & Documentation
Conduct legal research on SaaS, data protection, intellectual property, and technology regulations.
Draft internal policies, SOPs, and compliance reports.
Assist senior legal team members in preparing legal summaries and opinions.
Cross-Functional Support
Liaise with HR, Sales, Finance, and Product teams to address routine legal queries.
Support in responding to RFPs, due diligence requests, and client compliance questionnaires.
Work closely with the Product team to refine terms of service based on new feature rollouts.
Collaborate with the Engineering team to keep the third-party components license page updated.
Licensing & IP Awareness
Strong understanding of open-source licenses such as Apache, MIT, and copyright/copyleft frameworks.
Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB).
2–3 years of experience in a corporate/tech/startup/SaaS environment.
Basic knowledge of contract law, IT law, and intellectual property.
Strong legal drafting, research, and organizational skills.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced tech environment.
jobDescription:

The role involves end-to-end contract management, compliance oversight, and cross-functional legal support. You will be responsible for drafting and reviewing agreements, maintaining governance processes, conducting legal research, and ensuring compliance with IT and data privacy regulations. This role requires strong drafting and research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with multiple teams including Product, Engineering, HR, Sales, and Finance. Key Responsibilities
- Contract Support
- Draft, review, and manage standard agreements (NDAs, vendor agreements, Saa S contracts, consultancy agreements).
- Maintain the central repository of contracts and track renewals/expiry dates.
- Ensure execution and filing of contracts in line with company policies.
- Compliance & Governance
- Support compliance with IT laws, data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act), and internal policies.
- Assist with corporate secretarial activities including board resolutions, filings, and documentation.
- Maintain legal checklists and ensure timely updates.
- Legal Research & Documentation
- Conduct legal research on Saa S, data protection, intellectual property, and technology regulations.
- Draft internal policies, SOPs, and compliance reports.
- Assist senior legal team members in preparing legal summaries and opinions.
- Cross-Functional Support
- Liaise with HR, Sales, Finance, and Product teams to address routine legal queries.
- Support in responding to RFPs, due diligence requests, and client compliance questionnaires.
- Work closely with the Product team to refine terms of service based on new feature rollouts.
- Collaborate with the Engineering team to keep the third-party components license page updated.
- Licensing & IP Awareness
- Strong understanding of open-source licenses such as Apache, MIT, and copyright/copyleft frameworks. Must-Have Skills
- Bachelor’s degree in Law (LLB).
- 2–3 years of experience in a corporate/tech/startup/Saa S environment.
- Basic knowledge of contract law, IT law, and intellectual property.
- Strong legal drafting, research, and organizational skills.
- Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced tech environment. Why join us?
- Be at the forefront of tech law – Work on cutting-edge legal issues in Saa S, data privacy, and intellectual property.
- Cross-functional exposure – Collaborate with Product, Engineering, HR, Sales, and Finance teams to see the direct business impact of your work.
- Learning & growth – Opportunity to build expertise in technology law, licensing frameworks, and global compliance regulations.
- Dynamic work culture – Join a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment where your ideas and proactive approach are valued.

title: QA Lead – SaaS (Low-Code/No-Code)
requiredSkills: Quality Assurance & Product Testing
Define and execute QA strategies tailored for Low-Code/No-Code platform development.
Collaborate with engineering, product, and customer success teams to uphold product quality.
Design and manage automated and manual test frameworks for UI, APIs, and integrations.
Detect, track, and resolve defects to ensure seamless performance across web and mobile.
Establish performance, security, and scalability benchmarks for the SaaS platform.
Process Optimization & Compliance
Implement quality management systems (QMS) aligned with ISO, SOC 2, GDPR, and other standards.
Optimize CI/CD pipelines to integrate automated quality checks and accelerate releases.
Monitor SaaS KPIs (uptime, latency, error rates) to identify trends and improvements.
Customer-Centric Quality Improvement
Leverage user feedback, support tickets, and NPS scores to detect recurring issues.
Partner with customer success to enhance reliability and satisfaction.
Develop and implement RCA frameworks for system failures and service disruptions.
Collaboration & Leadership
Lead a team of QA engineers, automation testers, and security analysts.
Provide training on QA best practices, security, and compliance.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement across product, engineering, and support teams.
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
5+ years in SaaS QA, testing, or quality management (experience with Low-Code/No-Code preferred).
ISTQB, Six Sigma, Agile/DevOps certifications.
Proficiency in automated testing tools (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, etc.).
Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar).
Knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR).
Analytical problem-solving with a proactive approach.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Adaptability to fast-paced Agile/Scrum environments.
